=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:113-196 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `dv_listing_read_ok` is set to 1 whenever `gh_api_retry` exits 0 (lines 113-117/115-118 and 159-163/161-163). This happens before `_jobs_json_valid` checks the body (lines 135-141). An rc-0 reply with an invalid body therefore counts as a successful listing read. If a later recheck returns rc 75 or rc 2, the fail-closed guard at lines 184-186 is skipped and lines 193-196 report a "spurious re-trigger — OK".
  WHY: Deep verification can pass a phase without ever seeing a valid jobs listing, and `test_empty_listing_then_failed_recheck_stays_spurious` only covers a valid empty body. Reviewers disagreed on severity: MAJOR (minimax, openai) vs NIT (glm), so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered this finding and did not report it, because `gh_api_retry` returns 0 only on 2xx with a jobs array and the gap existed before the last run.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4326-4337 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrate-decompose-test timeout increase to 101 minutes budgets 1,200 s for only one `gh_api_retry` read. The dispatch and cleanup steps contain several independent rate-limit-aware reads (lines 4530-4618 and 4723-4745).
  WHY: A second rate-limited read could add another 1,200 s past the 101-minute budget, so GitHub could cancel the job before its `always()` cleanup finishes. Rated MAJOR. minimax and glm raised the same concern only as low-risk hardening suggestions (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1), on the grounds that a primary reset cannot repeat within the job. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked the arithmetic and found at most about 2100 s of waiting against 2700 s budgeted.

- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:lines 113-117 (initial read loop), lines 159-186 (fail-closed guard) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3 (2 related items: CORRECTNESS & LOGIC and ERROR PATHS & EDGE CASES)
  PROBLEM: `dv_listing_read_ok` is set to 1 on any `gh_api_retry` rc 0 before the body is schema-validated. The initial 3-attempt loop never runs `_jobs_json_valid`, and the recheck loop breaks on rc 75 or rc 2 before validating.
  WHY: An rc-0 non-JSON first read (proxy 200, truncated payload, or an HTML-wrapped error) followed by rate-limited rechecks suppresses the "Jobs listing unavailable" verdict and reports a "spurious re-trigger — OK". Fix: set the flag only after `_jobs_json_valid "$JOBS_JSON"` passes.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:lines 4326-4330, lines 4408-4411; tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py:344-350 | HARDENING_SUGGESTION | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The 1,200 s reserve covers one `gh_api_retry` read, but the job contains many independent reads, and `test_pat_jobs_bound_helper_waits` checks only one read's worst-case wait.
  WHY: Runtime risk is low because the primary core reset cannot repeat within 101 minutes, but the comment does not say why. Fix: a one-line note on reset refill and short secondary retry-afters (2 lines).

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:lines 115-118, lines 161-163, lines 135-141, line 186 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `dv_listing_read_ok` is set on the raw return code before validation. An exit-0 body that fails `_jobs_json_valid` is replaced with `{"jobs":[]}` but still counts as "listing read". A later rc 75 or rc 2 recheck then skips the line-186 guard, and the phase prints "Run has no jobs after retries (spurious re-trigger) — OK" with `deep_passed=true`.
  WHY: A 200-classified reply that is not a jobs object counts as evidence the run was indexed, so deep verify passes an unverified phase, which is exactly what the fail-closed change was meant to prevent. Fix: set the flag only when `_jobs_json_valid "$JOBS_JSON"` passes, and move the recheck flag into the line-176 validity branch.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:`orchestrate-decompose-test` job comment above `timeout-minutes: 101` (and the dispatch-step budget comment) | HARDENING_SUGGESTION | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The budget reserves (3-1) x 600 s for one `gh_api_retry` reset wait, but the dispatch and cleanup steps contain several independent reads.
  WHY: Fix: add a comment line explaining that a second full reset wait cannot occur in one job and that secondary waits are bounded by retry-after (1-2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
